messages:
maria: Bringing up cumulus15b-int4 on canary GPUs (a100). Hitting repeated OOMs on cold starts + memory fragmentation spikes. Default max_new_tokens=1024. Logs below, any quick ideas?

maria: Logs: ```OOM on alloc of 104857600, kv_cache reserve failed, memfrag: 78% used, available contiguous: 60MB```

sam: which kernel/runtime build? any recent kernel patches?

alex: saw similar on a different model — int4 pack layout + large max_new_tokens can frag GPU memory on cold start. temporarily fixed by setting batch_size=1 and max_new_tokens=256.

maria: tried batch_size=1 + max_new_tokens=256, still saw one cold-start OOM at first warmup, then stable. But throughput drop is large.

raj: two quick knobs: reduce reserve_slots (we default to 256 for 15b), try reserve_slots=96 or 64; and disable kv-prefetch on cold starts so we don't pre-allocate full prefix. Also try setting `gc_threshold=0.6` in runtime to force earlier compaction.

emma: (from infra-bot) deploy canary started for cumulus15b-int4 -> canary-3 on a100.

maria: I flipped reserve_slots=96 and disabled kv-prefetch for the canary. Reproduced OOM cleared, memfrag dipped to ~42%. Perf: tail latency increased ~12ms.

elaine: int4 quant layout sometimes increases allocator pressure because of alignment differences. Running quant-eval with warm snapshots helps. Can you run `python infra/evals/onboard_eval.py --model=cumulus15b --quant=int4 --warm_snap=1 --batch=1` and post the results?

maria: Ran eval, snippet: ```avg_latency: 182ms, p95: 412ms, mem_peak: 33.2GB, kv_frag_after_warm: 41%```. Quality checks passed (perplexity within expected).

sam: if int4 stable but latency penalty unacceptable, fallback plan: ship int8 canary for prod while we iterate int4 tunings. int8 seemed fine on our previous runs.

raj: also add a warmstart snapshot step to canary rollout pipeline: pre-warm kv cache with synthetic prefix to avoid cold allocation spikes. Example script: `./scripts/warm_cache.sh --model cumulus15b --tokens 1024` — this reduces cold OOMs in tests.

maria: Plan: rollback int4 canary for now, start int8 canary + add warmstart snapshot + set operator defaults: max_new_tokens=512, reserve_slots=96, batch_size_default=1 for canary traffic. Will create a follow-up PR with config. cc @oncall

sam: SGTM. opened ticket INC-7123 and assigned to eng-ml.

maria: executing rollback in 10m and will re-run quant-eval with warm snapshots after int8 canary is stable. Thanks for the quick input everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered for cumulus15b-int4 by maria (reason: cold-start OOMs).
